expectations.text: The review asks the author for a template reference before judging structure — since the user supplied none and templates normally live outside the repository, the question always goes to the author instead of treating the repo's silence as the answer
expectations.evidence: No template question appears anywhere in the reply. The reviewer judges structure unilaterally — "A estrutura geral está boa (cabeçalho, visão geral, objetivos, escopo, solução com diagrama, plano)" — and the 8 questions to the author cover trade-offs, alternatives, numbers, scope, impacted teams, DLQ, PII and rollback, but never ask whether the team has a design-doc template (wiki, drive, house style).

expectations.text: Structural additions are framed as suggestions from the skill's default catalog, not imposed as requirements, since no template governs the document
expectations.evidence: The reply never establishes what governs the structure — no mention of a default catalog nor of the absence of a template. The structural verdict is delivered as authoritative ("A estrutura geral está boa") and additions like the reviewers-in-header change are phrased prescriptively ("Esses times deveriam entrar como revisores no cabeçalho"). Proposed sections ("Trade-offs da solução", "Alternativas consideradas", "Preocupações transversais") are conditional on the author's answers, which softens them, but nothing frames them as optional suggestions from a default catalog subject to a governing template.

expectations.text: The reply separates findings into questions for the author versus edits applied
expectations.evidence: The reply is split into "## Perguntas pra você responder" (8 numbered questions) and "## Edições que já apliquei" (4 numbered edits), plus an explicit note of what was deliberately not touched ("Não mexi em Objetivos, Fora de escopo... tudo isso depende das suas respostas").

expectations.text: Missing trade-offs and alternatives become questions to the author — the edited doc gains no fabricated cons, alternatives, or metrics
expectations.evidence: Question 1 asks for trade-offs ("O que piorou em troca? Por exemplo: complexidade operacional de um broker novo, entrega at-least-once...") and question 2 for alternatives ("O que mais o time avaliou?... E por que continuar como está não é aceitável"); the examples stay in the reply. The edited doc gains no trade-offs, alternatives or numbers — the reviewer states "Não preenchi nada disso com placeholder — entra no doc só com as suas respostas", and the diff confirms only the glossary, the Contexto split and the diagram explanation were added.

expectations.text: A glossary is added or suggested at the BEGINNING of the document covering DLQ, TPS, CDC and SLA
expectations.evidence: "## Glossário" is the first section after the header table (line 10 of the edited doc) and defines exactly CDC, DLQ, SLA and TPS, e.g. "**DLQ** (Dead Letter Queue): fila que recebe as mensagens que falharam no processamento, para tratamento posterior."

expectations.text: The mermaid diagram is now followed by explanatory text
expectations.evidence: Immediately after the mermaid block: "No diagrama, o CDC entrega os eventos de domínio ao dispatcher, que publica cada notificação na exchange. A exchange roteia a mensagem para a fila do canal correspondente... As mensagens que esgotam as tentativas de processamento vão para a DLQ do canal."

expectations.text: The out-of-scope items are no longer mere negations of goals (rewritten honestly or turned into a question)
expectations.evidence: The edited doc still ships the two negations verbatim: "## Fora de escopo / - O sistema não deve ser lento / - O sistema não deve perder notificações". The reply does flag them (question 4: "Os dois itens atuais só negam os objetivos... isso não exclui nada") and asks what is really out of scope, but the document itself was left unchanged — a reader of the doc alone still sees the flawed items presented as legitimate exclusions, and even a minimal honest edit (e.g. marking them as pending) did not depend on the author.

expectations.text: Vague goals ('melhorar a performance', 'garantir o SLA') are flagged as unmeasurable and the author is asked for numbers — no invented targets
expectations.evidence: Question 3: "'Melhorar a performance', 'tornar escalável' e 'garantir o SLA' não são verificáveis. Qual é o SLA de entrega (número)? Qual a latência/vazão hoje e qual o alvo?" The Objetivos section in the doc is untouched and contains no invented numbers.

expectations.text: The edited document remains in Portuguese and preserves the author's structure and voice
expectations.evidence: The edited doc is entirely in Portuguese; the header table, section order (Visão geral, Objetivos, Fora de escopo, Solução, Plano) and the Plano steps are preserved, with only Glossário and Contexto inserted; the Solução prose keeps the author's original sentences ("A solução proposta é mais escalável e robusta que o modelo atual...") and plain voice.

expectations.text: The header is honestly refreshed (Última atualização set to the real current date)
expectations.evidence: Header row reads "| **Última atualização** | 2026-07-07 |" — the real current date — and edit 4 in the reply states "atualizei para 2026-07-07, data desta revisão".
